theater: 波河三角洲與亞平寧山區

battle.name: 那不勒斯戰爭
battle.theater: 波河三角洲與亞平寧山區
battle.brief: 一八一五年三月，穆拉特王聞拿破崙逃出厄爾巴，便對奧地利宣戰，近五萬大軍自安科納沿艾米利亞大道北上，連取博洛尼亞、摩德納，並在里米尼發表號召起義的公告。奧軍在波河三角洲奧基奧貝洛扭轉戰局，再於托倫蒂諾迫其議和，五月二十日訂卡薩蘭察條約。輪發槍此時僅存軍械庫，線上開火的已是燧發手槍。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 一八一五年三月至五月，交戰的兩方是拿破崙系的義大利那不勒斯王國與反法同盟。交戰方之一是那不勒斯王國：國王若阿尚·穆拉特是法國元帥、拿破崙的妹夫，一八〇八年受封為王，一八一五年對外稱兩西西里之王；王國軍隊以法語系老兵為骨架，步兵用前裝滑膛燧發步槍，炮兵沿用法國制式，另有王室近衛兩個師團與外籍傭兵團；軍令由穆拉特與總參謀部直接下達，軍需與徵發靠地方行政與修道院存糧的臨時徵用，軍紀與士氣都繫於王的個人威望。反方是奧地利帝國的義大利方面軍：作戰指揮交給弗里蒙男爵，其下分為比安基、尼佩格、紐根特等軍團，並受倫巴第總督貝利加德的節制；奧軍由維也納參謀總部統一補給，能沿倫巴第與上亞德利亞的兵站線連續調兵，炮兵與工程兵齊備。第三方是教宗國：教宗庇護七世指責穆拉特違約，倉皇逃往熱那亞，其後教宗軍與奧軍同行作戰，並在羅馬恢復教宗統治。第四方是英國與西西里王國：英國從未承認穆拉特的王位，始終在巴勒莫護庇波旁王室的斐迪南，宣戰後即派艦隊前往義大利，並在戰事後期加入封鎖；那不勒斯王國內的波旁派軍官與西西里旅團則是穆拉特的內部反對力量，待大軍潰敗便迎接斐迪南回國。
countriesEn: The war fought from March to May 1815 pitted the Napoleonic Kingdom of Naples against the anti-French alliance. On one side stood the Kingdom of Naples. Its king, Joachim Murat, was a French marshal and Napoleon's brother-in-law, crowned in 1808 and styling himself King of the Two Sicilies in 1815. The army of the kingdom was built around French-speaking veterans: infantry carried smoothbore flintlock muskets, the artillery followed French patterns, and there were two divisions of royal guard together with several foreign regiments. Orders came straight from Murat and his general staff, while supply and conscription ran on improvised requisitions from local authorities and monastic granaries; discipline and morale in the whole army hung on the king's personal prestige. On the other side stood the Austrian army in Italy. Operational command was given to Baron Johann Maria Philipp Frimont, with corps under Friedrich Bianchi, Adam Albert von Neipperg and Laval Nugent, all under the wider authority of Count Heinrich von Bellegarde in Lombardy. The Austrian corps drew supply from the commissariat at Vienna and could shift troops continuously along the depots of Lombardy and Upper Adriatic Italy, with artillery and engineer troops complete. The third party was the Papal States: Pope Pius VII denounced Murat's breach of faith and fled in haste to Genoa; papal troops afterwards marched alongside the Austrians, and the Pope was restored to Rome. The fourth was Britain together with the Kingdom of Sicily. London had never recognised Murat's title, kept Ferdinand under protection at Palermo, and once war was declared sent a squadron to Italy, joining the blockade in the later stages; Bourbon officers and Sicilian regiments inside Naples formed the internal opposition, ready to welcome Ferdinand back as soon as Murat's army broke.
people: 穆拉特是這場戰爭的關鍵人物，也是它的始作俑者。他出身卡爾洛納沒落的騎士家庭，靠軍功與姻親關係上位，娶了拿破崙的妹妹卡羅琳，成為法國元帥；能征善戰，騎兵衝鋒極有名聲，但政治嗅覺遠不如軍事才幹。他一八一五年一月仍與奧地利訂約，宣稱站在反法同盟一邊，三月聽聞拿破崙逃出厄爾巴島便立刻翻臉，十五日對奧地利宣戰。三十日在里米尼發表公告，號召意大利人起來把奧地利逐出半島，卻沒有得到預想的響應，義大利民眾多數只當他是在保命保位。手下將領各有一段戲：外國出身的卡拉斯科薩在摩德納周邊獨當一面，看穿奧軍的包抄便主動退到帕納羅河後方；古列爾莫·佩佩守卡爾皮，是堅持繼續抵抗的一派；弗里德里希·比安基在切塞納前哨被擊退後退守帕納羅河線，逐次讓出摩德納、雷焦與費拉拉，把穆拉特拖入攻城的僵局；尼佩格與紐根特分別率兩支部隊南北夾擊，紐根特還在佛羅倫薩擊退那不勒斯近衛師團。教宗庇護七世在戰爭中兩度流亡，最終由紐根特讓出羅馬。戰後斐迪南四世重登那不勒斯王座，一八一六年成為兩西西里王國的斐迪南一世；穆拉特則在同年十月被處決。
peopleEn: Murat is the central figure of this war and the man who set it in motion. He came from a ruined family of small knights in Carignano, rose through military service and a marriage of convenience to Napoleon's sister Caroline, and became a French marshal. He was a genuinely gifted battlefield commander, famous above all for cavalry attacks, but his political instincts were far weaker than his military ones. In January 1815 he was still negotiating with Austria and claiming to stand with the anti-French coalition; in March, on hearing that Napoleon had escaped Elba, he turned on Austria at once and declared war on the fifteenth. On the thirtieth he issued the proclamation at Rimini, calling on the Italians to drive Austria off the peninsula, and it produced no response worth the name: most Italians read it as the act of a man saving his own throne rather than as a call to a national rising. His commanders each played their own part. Carrascosa, a foreigner by birth, commanded alone around Modena, saw the Austrian pincer coming and withdrew of his own accord to a line behind the Panaro. Guglielmo Pepe held Carpi and belonged to the party that insisted on continuing the fight. Friedrich Bianchi, pushed back by the Neapolitan vanguard near Cesena, fell back to the Panaro and gave up Modena, Reggio and Ferrara one by one, dragging Murat into the deadlock of a siege. Neipperg and Nugent led two separate columns in the north and south, and Nugent turned back the Neapolitan guard divisions at Florence. Pope Pius VII was twice in exile and was finally allowed back into Rome by Nugent. After the war Ferdinand IV regained the Neapolitan throne and in 1816 became Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies; Murat was executed in the October of the same year.
kits: 卡面這件輪發槍是十六世紀初的後膛手槍，靠發條驅動擊鎚打擊火盤上的燧石點火，不必像火繩槍那樣讓射手舉著火繩。它在十六世紀是典型貴重裝備，機械費工，只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛騎士，一八一五年早已停產三百年，存世者多為王宮與軍械庫的舊藏，只在典禮與儀仗上出現。實際上這場戰爭裡開火的是燧發手槍與燧發步槍：奧地利步兵裝備一八一五年式燧發步槍，那不勒斯步兵沿用前裝滑膛燧發步槍，騎兵配燧發手槍與馬刀，炮兵用前裝滑膛三至六磅野戰炮與榴彈炮，穆拉特一方宣稱共有九十門炮，此數明顯誇大。攻城靠的是封鎖與炮兵而非攻城塔：費拉拉的城堡憑高牆拖住大批那不勒斯兵；安科納在英奧聯合艦隊封鎖後，守軍未遭強攻即全軍淪為俘虜。運輸與補給同樣決定戰局：穆拉特的軍隊靠陸路沿艾米利亞大道與亞平寧山道行軍，糧秣要從摩德納、雷焦一線臨時徵收，馬匹飼料幾乎無處可取；聯軍則以海運把奧軍送上亞得里亞海各口岸，機動範圍遠勝對手，也讓英國得以用封鎖代替登陸作戰。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card face is a breech-loading handgun of the early sixteenth century: a wound mechanism drives a hammer onto a pyrite held in a dog, so that no smouldering match cord has to be carried aloft. In the sixteenth century it was a costly piece of equipment, its mechanism too expensive for general issue, and it went to officers of the musket corps and to guards; by 1815 it had been out of production for three centuries, and the surviving examples were armory and palace pieces, seen at court ceremonies rather than on campaign. The weapons that actually fired in this war were flintlock pistols and flintlock muskets. Austrian infantry carried the Model 1815 flintlock musket; Neapolitan infantry still used smoothbore flintlock muskets; cavalry carried flintlock pistols and sabres; and the artillery used smoothbore three- and six-pounder field guns with howitzers, against a claimed total of ninety pieces, a figure plainly inflated. Siege work rested on blockade and artillery rather than on towers: the citadel of Ferrara held a large body of Neapolitan troops behind its walls, and Ancona fell with its whole garrison taken prisoner once the Anglo-Austrian fleet blockaded it, no storming being required. Transport and supply decided as much as the fighting did. Murat's army moved on its legs along the Via Emilia and the Apennine roads, drawing grain and fodder by improvised requisition around Modena and Reggio, with almost no grazing for the horses; the allies shipped their Austrian corps by sea to the Adriatic ports, could thus range far wider than their opponent, and let Britain substitute blockade for an invasion.
tactics: 穆拉特的計畫是趁奧軍主力調去對付拿破崙的空檔，以三路北進：兩個近衛師團經教宗國直取佛羅倫薩，兩支主力師自安科納沿艾米利亞大道指向博洛尼亞，主力則集結在摩德納與費拉拉之間。問題是三路分得太散，彼此不能呼應，而每一路都得靠徵糧維持，穿越艾米利亞與亞平寧的鄉村幾乎沒有現成秣草。三月三十日在切塞納前哨，那不勒斯前衛打散奧軍前哨卻未能乘勢擴張戰果；比安基站穩帕納羅河線，穆拉特占領博洛尼亞後立即轉向費拉拉，用重兵圍困堅固的要塞城，兵力被釘在城下，這是整場戰役最關鍵的失著。奧軍反制十分典型：弗里蒙不與穆拉特爭奪城市，而以尼佩格部偷襲其右翼，同時封死佩佩部的退路，逼卡拉斯科薩退到帕納羅河後方；比安基站穩後以兩支縱隊南北夾擊，一路經佛羅倫薩取福爾利尼奧切斷退路，一路在後緊追不捨。穆拉特的騎兵每次都放在進攻前線，用密集衝鋒去撞奧軍方陣的前沿，屢次得手卻始終撕不開正面，傷亡卻在累積。主力退回安科納後，他仍迷信近衛師團，行軍拖成緩慢撤退，在切塞納蒂科與佩薩羅兩度被追兵從後方追上。最後的托倫蒂諾之役，他以卡拉斯科薩一部去擋尼佩格，主力西向迎擊比安基，兩日不分勝負之下得知卡拉斯科薩在斯卡佩扎諾戰敗，隨即下令退兵。
tacticsEn: Murat's plan was to advance north in three columns while the Austrian main army was being turned against Napoleon: two guard divisions went through the Papal States to seize Florence, two of the main divisions pushed north from Ancona along the Via Emilia toward Bologna, and the bulk of the army was concentrated between Modena and Ferrara. The fault was that the columns were spread too thin to support one another, and each had to live off requisitions, while the country across the Apennines and the Emilia offered almost no standing forage. On 30 March the Neapolitan vanguard broke up the Austrian outpost near Cesena but failed to turn the moment into a general advance; Bianchi settled on the line of the Panaro, and Murat, having taken Bologna, immediately turned on Ferrara, tying down large numbers of men before the fortified citadel, the decisive blunder of the campaign. The Austrian counterstroke was characteristic: Frimont did not fight Murat for towns but sent Neipperg against his right flank and sealed Pepe's line of retreat, forcing Carrascosa back behind the Panaro; once established, Bianchi worked two columns in from the north and south, one through Florence to Foligno to cut the retreat, the other in close pursuit. Murat habitually put his cavalry in front, throwing dense charges against the Austrian line, and they often succeeded without ever breaking the front, while the losses piled up. Once the main force was back at Ancona, still trusting his guard divisions, he turned the withdrawal into a slow march and was twice surprised from behind at Cesenatico and Pesaro. At Tolentino he detached Carrascosa to hold off Neipperg and turned the main force west against Bianchi; after two days of indecision, news that Carrascosa had been beaten at Scapezzano forced him to order the retreat.
data: 時間：戰爭自一八一五年三月十五日穆拉特宣戰起，至五月二十日簽訂卡薩蘭察條約止，前後約兩個月零五天，另有安科納封鎖與十月穆拉特在皮佐被處決的尾聲。兵力：穆拉特自報八萬二千人、七千騎兵、九十門炮，此數明顯誇大，較可靠的估計是其可用兵力約五萬；他留下內陸守備軍以防西西里方向偷襲，主要兵力集中於艾米利亞戰線。奧地利在倫巴第的兵力一度增至約六萬，弗里蒙奉召回倫巴第籌備對法作戰後，留守中義的三個軍團合計約三萬五千人。傷亡：奧基奧貝洛一戰那不勒斯方面損失逾二千人，此數有較具體記載；其餘各役數字各家說法不一，多屬估算。距離與行程：主力自安科納到博洛尼亞約二百公里，再往西至托倫蒂諾約五十公里；安科納至那不勒斯陸路約四百公里；最後穆拉特僅帶二十八人登陸皮佐，五日後即被處決。堅城與封鎖：費拉拉被圍數週，安科納守軍在英奧聯合封鎖下全部淪為俘虜，那不勒斯灣內的穆拉特炮艇在英國艦隊到達後被全部毀滅。物資：那不勒斯王國當時人口約五百萬，軍糧依賴鄉村徵收與修道院存糧，遠征一旦拉長便立刻見底。
dataEn: Timing: the war ran from Murat's declaration on 15 March 1815 to the Treaty of Casalanza on 20 May, about two months and five days, with the blockade of Ancona and Murat's execution at Pizzo in October forming the tail. Numbers of men: Murat claimed 82,000 men, 7,000 cavalry and ninety guns, figures plainly inflated; the more reliable estimate puts his usable force at about 50,000. He left an interior army behind to cover the Sicilian flank and concentrated the bulk of his strength on the Emilia. The Austrian force in Lombardy swelled to some 60,000 at one point, and after Frimont was ordered back to Lombardy to prepare the army against France, three corps totalling around 35,000 men remained in central Italy. Losses: at Occhiobello the Neapolitan side is recorded as losing more than 2,000 men, one of the better-attested figures; for the other actions the sources disagree and the figures are estimates. Distances and marches: the main body covered roughly 200 kilometres from Ancona to Bologna and a further fifty kilometres west to Tolentino; the land road from Ancona to Naples is about 400 kilometres; and Murat finally landed at Pizzo with only twenty-eight men and was executed five days later. Fortresses and blockade: Ferrara was besieged for weeks, the garrison of Ancona was taken entire once the Anglo-Austrian blockade closed, and Murat's gunboats in the bay of Naples were all destroyed when the British fleet arrived. Supplies: the Kingdom of Naples had some five million inhabitants, and the army's grain came from village requisitions and monastic stores, so that once the march was extended the magazines ran dry.
cause: 直接起因是拿破崙的一八一五年百日。穆拉特在萊比錫戰敗後一度脫離大軍，一八一五年一月仍與奧地利訂約，宣稱加入反法同盟，並承諾放棄對波旁王室的繼承權，以為只要緊跟勝利者就能保住王位。但維也納會議的走向、斐迪南在英國庇護下重返西西里、以及穆拉特本人與法國王室的姻親身分，都讓他的處境越來越危險；當三月一日拿破崙逃出厄爾巴島的消息傳到那不勒斯，穆拉特立刻明白，奧地利完成部署之後必然會先解決他。三月十五日他對奧地利宣戰，一半是恐懼，一半也是算計：他想用一場快速的北征，趕在聯軍集結之前攻下倫巴第、激發意大利民族起義，再以解放者的身份保住王位，這正是里米尼公告的用意。深層原因則是拿破崙時代的體制改造尚未被聯盟消化：米蘭、托斯卡納與摩德納被奧地利還原舊制，費迪南三世出逃比薩，教宗國境內的法國派與革命派仍多，這些都讓穆拉特以為自己還有可以收割的政治資本。英國的態度同樣關鍵：英國從未承認穆拉特的王位，斐迪南一直由英國護送守在巴勒莫，英國的艦隊與外交支持，是穆拉特低估得最厲害的兩項變數。
causeEn: The immediate cause was Napoleon's Hundred Days. After the defeat at Leipzig Murat had detached himself from the great army, and in January 1815 he was still negotiating with Austria, professing his adhesion to the anti-French coalition and pledging to renounce the Bourbon succession in order to save his own throne. But the drift of the Congress of Vienna, Ferdinand's return to Sicily under British protection, and Murat's own connection by marriage to the French royal house all made his position steadily more dangerous. When the news of Napoleon's escape from Elba reached Naples on 1 March, Murat understood at once that once the Austrians had finished their deployments he would be the one to be dealt with. He declared war on Austria on 15 March, half from fear and half from calculation: a quick march north might beat the allies to the draw, stir an Italian national rising, and leave him a liberator, which was precisely the intent of the proclamation at Rimini. The deeper cause lies in the fact that the settlements of the Napoleonic years had not yet been digested by the coalition. Milan, Tuscany and Modena were being restored to their old order, Ferdinand III had fled to Pisa, and French and revolutionary parties still abounded inside the Papal States; all of this convinced Murat that political capital remained to be harvested. Britain's attitude mattered just as much: London had never recognised his title, Ferdinand was kept under British protection at Palermo, and the British fleet and diplomatic backing were the two variables he underestimated most.
impact: 戰爭結束後，穆拉特王國覆滅，斐迪南四世復辟，但更長遠的影響分三個層面。其一，義大利半島的格局被重塑：奧地利把倫巴第與威尼斯整合為倫巴第－威尼斯王國，維也納確立的奧地利主導局面在義大利北部落地，激起了南方對奧勢力的反感，一八二零年那不勒斯革命、一八四八年西西里與米蘭等地的起義，都能在這場戰爭留下的怨憤裡找到線頭。其二，穆拉特提出的意大利民族動員說法雖當時無人響應，卻常被後世視為義大利統一運動的濫觴，里米尼公告與把奧地利逐出半島這類訴求在政治記憶中長期保留下來。其三，歐洲國際秩序：這是維也納體系第一次用軍事手段清除拿破崙系的國家，也是英國海上封鎖作為政策工具的一次示範，聯軍不必登陸作戰，只要封死海岸線，穆拉特連回國的船都沒有，此後歐洲大國處理革命王國時，軍事干預加海上封鎖成為標準做法。軍隊層面亦然：穆拉特麾下的法語系老兵與南意大利士兵在潰散後成為各國僱傭兵與流匪的來源，而波旁復辟後對本土主義者與燒炭黨的鎮壓，埋下一八二零年革命的種子。
impactEn: The war ended with the destruction of Murat's kingdom and the restoration of Ferdinand IV, but its longer consequences run along three lines. First, the political geography of the peninsula was reset: Austria consolidated Lombardy and Venice into the Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia, and the Austrian predominance fixed at Vienna took root in northern Italy, sharpening southern resentment of Habsburg power; the Neapolitan revolution of 1820 and the risings in Sicily and Milan in 1848 can both be traced back to the resentment this campaign left behind. Second, the idea of mobilising an Italian nation, which nobody answered in Murat's own lifetime, was later read as the opening move of the Risorgimento, and the proclamation at Rimini and the demand to drive Austria off the peninsula stayed alive in political memory long after the guns were silent. Third, in the international order of Europe: this was the first time the Vienna system removed a Napoleonic state by force, and it was a demonstration of British blockade as an instrument of policy, since the allies never needed to invade, needing only to close the coastline and leave Murat without a ship to sail home; from then on, military intervention combined with a maritime cordon became the standard way of dealing with revolutionary states. At the level of the armies the effect was equally lasting: the French-speaking veterans and southern Italian soldiers of Murat's host dispersed into foreign service and into bands of brigands, while the Bourbon repression of localists and Carbonari after the restoration planted the seed of the revolution of 1820.
result: 結果是奧地利與英國聯軍完勝。穆拉特的北征在四月初受挫於奧基奧貝洛，五月初在托倫蒂諾一戰中主力與前衛同時脫離接觸，士氣崩潰；四月二十九日比安基的前衛已驅走托倫蒂諾守軍並據守東面高地，三十日紐根特進抵羅馬，教宗得以返國，奧軍兩部會師於卡爾維後向那不勒斯進軍。五月十六日穆拉特在聖傑爾馬諾阻止紐根特的企圖失敗，只能取消行動；五月二十日佩佩與卡拉斯科薩代表那不勒斯方面與奧地利訂立卡薩蘭察條約，戰爭就此結束，五月二十三日奧軍主力進入那不勒斯，斐迪南重登王座。穆拉特本人帶二十八人於十月八日在卡拉布里亞的皮佐登陸企圖復國，五日後即被捕，十月十三日在該城城堡被槍決；安科納守軍與費拉拉守軍在戰役中相繼投降或被俘，英國艦隊則在封鎖中摧毀那不勒斯灣內全部炮艇。最後的清算由波旁王朝完成：一八一六年那不勒斯與西西里兩王國合併為兩西西里王國，斐迪南稱一世，奧地利在北部取得倫巴第－威尼斯王國，而穆拉特在義大利半島的名聲則被貶為騎兵將軍的魯莽與背叛，雖然南部民眾對他的記憶遠比聯軍的官方敘述複雜得多。
resultEn: The outcome was an outright victory for the Austrian and British allies. Murat's northern drive stalled in early April at Occhiobello, and in the first days of May at Tolentino his main body and his advanced guard both lost contact, and the army's morale broke. On 29 April Bianchi's vanguard had driven out the small Neapolitan garrison at Tolentino and took up defensive ground on the hills to the east; on the thirtieth Nugent reached Rome and let the Pope return; and the two Austrian columns joined near Calvi before marching on Naples. On 16 May Murat tried to check Nugent at San Germano and failed, and had to call off the action. On 20 May Pepe and Carrascosa signed the Treaty of Casalanza with the Austrians on behalf of Naples, and the war was over; on 23 May the Austrian main army entered Naples and Ferdinand was restored. Murat himself landed with twenty-eight men at Pizzo in Calabria on 8 October in an attempt to recover his kingdom, was captured within five days, and was shot in the castle there on 13 October. The garrisons of Ancona and Ferrara surrendered or were taken prisoner in the course of the campaign, and the British fleet destroyed every gunboat in the bay of Naples during the blockade. The final settlement was carried out by the Bourbons: in 1816 the Kingdoms of Naples and Sicily were united as the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies under Ferdinand I, Austria took the Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia in the north, and Murat's name on the peninsula was written down as the rashness and treachery of a cavalry general, though the southern public remembered him far more warmly than the official account of the allies allowed.
